studio.customFonts.title: ifonti yami
studio.customFonts.selectTextFirst: Okokuqala khetha umbhalo noma ibhamuza lenkulumo
studio.customFonts.capacityExceeded: Isitoreji sisezingeni elingu-{used}/{max}, ngakho akukwazi ukwengeza okunye okungu-{size}.
studio.customFonts.cursorExpired: Umtapo wamafonti ushintshile futhi ikhesa yohlu iphelelwe yisikhathi. Sicela uvule iphaneli kabusha.
studio.customFonts.deleteFailedKeepList: Ayikwazanga ukusula ifonti yangokwezifiso kusitoreji sedivayisi, ngakho uhlu lugciniwe. Sicela uzame futhi emva kwesikhashana.
studio.customFonts.deleteIntegrityFailed: Ukusula kumisiwe ngenxa yephutha lobuqotho besitoreji sefonti yangokwezifiso. Vuselela ikhasi bese uzama futhi.
studio.customFonts.deleteRegisterFailed: Ifonti isuliwe, kodwa amafonti angu-{failed} ekhasini elisha awakwazanga ukubhaliswa ku-FontFace. Vuselela ikhasi bese uzama futhi.
studio.customFonts.deleteStorageUnavaila: Isitoreji se-SQLite/OPFS sefonti yangokwezifiso asitholakali, ngakho akukho okusuliwe.
studio.customFonts.durableSaveFailed: Ayikwazanga ukuqedela ukulondoloza kwe-SQLite/OPFS, ngakho ifonti ayingezwanga. Umtapo wakho okhona awushintshanga. Sicela uzame futhi emva kwesikhashana.
studio.customFonts.hydrationIntegrityFai: Ayikwazanga ukuqinisekisa ubuqotho bemanifesti yefonti yangokwezifiso noma ama-blob e-OPFS, ngakho ezinye izinto aziboniswanga. Vuselela ikhasi bese uzama futhi.
studio.customFonts.manifestCorruptImport: Imanifesti yefonti yangokwezifiso noma i-blob ye-OPFS yonakele, ngakho ukungenisa kumisiwe. Idatha ekhona ayibhalwanga ngaphezulu. Hlola ifayela bese uzama futhi.
studio.customFonts.memoryOnlyDeleted: Isulwe kuphela kwinkumbulo yale thebhu. Lokhu ngeke kusinde uma kuvuselelwa.
studio.customFonts.memoryOnlySaved: Ifonti ethi “{fontName}” igcinwe kuphela kwinkumbulo yale thebhu. Izonyamalala uma uvuselela.
studio.customFonts.nextPageReadFailed: Ayikwazanga ukufunda ngokuphepha ikhasi elilandelayo lamafonti angokwezifiso. Sicela uzame futhi emva kwesikhashana.
studio.customFonts.quotaExceededSave: Isitoreji sedivayisi asanele, ngakho ifonti ayingezwanga. Umtapo wakho okhona awushintshanga.
studio.customFonts.registerFailedMany: Kuqinisekiswe ubuqotho be-OPFS bamafonti angu-{total}, kodwa angu-{failed} awakwazanga ukubhaliswa ku-FontFace yalesi siphequluli. Vuselela ikhasi bese uzama futhi.
studio.customFonts.registerFailedMore: Kuhlolwe amanye amafonti angu-{count}, kodwa angu-{failed} awakwazanga ukubhaliswa ku-FontFace. Vuselela ikhasi bese uzama futhi.
studio.customFonts.storageCheckingImport: Ihlola umtapo we-SQLite/OPFS wamafonti angokwezifiso. Sicela uzame futhi emva kwesikhashana.
studio.customFonts.storageIntegrityBadge: Ukuhlola ubuqotho besitoreji kwehlulekile · Ukungenisa kumisiwe
studio.customFonts.storageIntegrityImpor: Ayikwazanga ukuqinisekisa ubuqotho besitoreji sefonti yangokwezifiso, ngakho ukungenisa kumisiwe. Vuselela ikhasi bese uzama futhi.
studio.customFonts.storageMemoryOnlyNoti: Ayikwazanga ukuvula i-SQLite/OPFS, ngakho kusetshenziswa inkumbulo yale thebhu kuphela. Amafonti azonyamalala uma uvuselela.
studio.customFonts.fileTooLarge: Ifayela lefonti lingu-{selectedFileSize}, okudlula umkhawulo wefayela ngalinye ongu-{limitSize}. Sicela uliguqulele kusethi encane ye-WOFF2 enesisindo osidingayo kuphela.
studio.customFonts.noticeUnsupported: Kwengezwe ifonti ethi “{fontName}”. Lesi siphequluli asikusekeli ukubuka kuqala.
studio.customFonts.readFailed: Ayikwazanga ukufunda ifayela lefonti. Sicela uhlole ukuthi ifayela lonakele yini.
studio.customFonts.description: Engeza amafayela akho e-{format} ukuze uwasebenzisele ukubhala izinhlamvu nemiphumela yomsindo.
studio.customFonts.emptyDescription: Engeza amafayela e-{format} onelayisensi yawo, bese uwasebenzisa khona manjalo enkulumweni nasemiphumeleni yomsindo.
